title: Markov chains through semigroup graph expansions (a survey)
comment: 14 pages. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:1711.10689, arXiv:1902.01042
abstract: We review the recent approach to Markov chains using the Karnofksy-Rhodes and McCammond expansions in semigroup theory by the authors and illustrate them by two examples.
